summary: A weekly Wednesday bring-your-own-or-borrow board and card game night hosted by Plant Bar - South Slope in its own taproom, framed as a casual bar promotion ("Grab a friend, grab a game...and grab a drink") rather than a club with members. No membership language, sign-up, or linked community (Facebook group, Discord, etc.) appears in the listings or on the venue's event page, which only offers a general newsletter signup.

evidence.note: Listing describes a low-key weekly bar night to bring or borrow games while drinking, with no mention of regulars, members, or sign-up.
Second listing repeats the same generic "grab a friend, grab a game, grab a drink" bar-promo framing with no membership or community language.
Fetched the venue's event page: it lists individual dated happenings and offers only a general email newsletter signup, no club, Facebook group, or Discord for regulars.
Organizer is the venue itself (Plant Bar - South Slope), matching the pattern of sibling venue-hosted game nights (Hi-Wire, RAD Brewing, Oak and Grist) already assessed as not_group.
